notes.text: Codification Sections 1427 to 1431 were omitted in the general revision of the United States Housing Act of 1937 by Pub. L. 93–383, title II, § 201(a), Aug. 22, 1974, 88 Stat. 653. Section 1427, act Sept. 1, 1937, ch. 896, § 28, formerly § 27, 50 Stat. 899, renumbered July 15, 1949, ch. 338, title III, § 307(h), 63 Stat. 431, provided for application of provisions when conflicting with other laws relating to housing or slum clearance. Section 1428, act Sept. 1, 1937, ch. 896, § 29, formerly § 28, 50 Stat. 899, renumbered July 15, 1949, ch. 338, title III, § 307(h), 63 Stat. 431, made available funds for the District of Columbia. Section 1429, act Sept. 1, 1937, ch. 896, § 30, formerly § 29, 50 Stat. 899, renumbered July 15, 1949, ch. 338, title III, § 307(h), 63 Stat. 431, provided for separability of provisions. Section 1430, act Sept. 1, 1937, ch. 896, § 31, formerly § 30, 50 Stat. 899, renumbered July 15, 1949, ch. 338, title III, § 307(h), 63 Stat. 431, set forth short title of provisions as “United States Housing Act of 1937”. See section 1 of act Sept. 1, 1937, as added by section 201(a) of Pub. L. 93–383, set out as a Short Title note under section 1437 of this title. Sectio
